verdict.rationale: Figma's official MCP server documents turning a selected frame into code and 'reading designs out of Figma', which gives an agent a programmatic path to production-format output. The REST API extracts objects, layers and their properties. However, no evidence in the pack shows a documented image-rendering, screenshot or asset-export endpoint or tool; SVG export appears only as a manual right-click action or via plugins. Missing for 10: documented programmatic image or screenshot rendering, export to formats like PNG/SVG/PDF via the API or MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven export.
